title: Your Muscle Can Shrink 35% Across Adulthood
hook: Adults can lose 35% of their muscle mass.
closing: Resistance training can reverse serious muscle loss, so starting sooner protects independence.
question: How often do you strength train?

segments.say: Muscle mass can fall 35% across adulthood. That loss can quietly reduce strength and independence.
After 70, muscle loss reaches 18% per decade. Waiting makes the decline much harder to recover from.
After training, clinical muscle loss fell to zero. Resistance work can reverse the condition, not just slow it.
